description.value: Cycology Bikes is a service-focused bicycle shop in Castlegar serving the West Kootenays cycling community, with particular expertise in e-bikes and in-house suspension rebuilds. The shop offers tiered service packages ranging from basic inspections to full-rebuild OCD-level overhauls, and performs all suspension work on-site. Beyond repairs, Cycology actively partners with the Castlegar Parks and Trails Society on local trail maintenance and the Millennium Park Bike Park project.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone, website). The services page explicitly lists e-bike service packages and describes on-the-spot intake inspection, supporting walk-in repairs and e-bike service claims. No evidence on the website for pump availability, rentals, touring parts, or most optional amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists Tu-Su (implying Sunday open), but the website explicitly marks Sunday as closed ('gone riding!'). The website value is likely more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, dedicated bike shop with verified contact details, comprehensive repair services including e-bike expertise, and strong local cycling community ties — a clear asset for touring cyclists passing through Castlegar and the West Kootenays.

E-bike service.detail: Website explicitly lists an 'E-Stress Tune' package covering drivetrain, battery, drive unit diagnostics, firmware update, and service reset; also states 'We are the local experts for E-bikes.'

wow_evidence: service-focused bicycle shop... e-bike expertise, in-house suspension rebuilds... partners with the Castlegar Parks and Trails Society
